page.layout: Full width: two parallel columns of signature lines (crosses with names) at the top, left column and right column; below them one block of running text; then two right-set signature lines at the foot of the text. No margin notes.

main_text.p: Anno à Natiuitate Domini millesimo quin-gentesimo octuagesimo quinto, indictione decimatertia, Die verò vigesima prima mensis Septembris, Pontificatus sanctiss. in Christo Patris, & D. N. D. Sixti diuina prouidentia Papæ quinti Anno primo, Retroscriptæ literæ affixæ, & publicatæ fuerunt in Basilica Principis Apostolorum de Vrbe, & in acie Campi Floræ per nos Hieronymum Lucium, & Nicolaum Talliettum, sanctiss. D.N.Papæ Curs.
Ioannes Caie[?]anus Cur.Card.Camera-ria Apostolica Ibotus Ful.

page.notes: Top of the page is faint; the first signature line ("Iul.Ant.Sanctorius Cardin.") and the "Sfortia" reading are doubtful. "Caie[?]anus" is a doubtful reading of the surname. "Curs." is printed with a long-s form ("Curf.") and is given as plain s. Faint show-through of text from the reverse side is visible across the lower half and is not transcribed. No running head, page number, catchword or signature mark is printed.
